description: Omit calling nullSafe() on the constructed type adapter, leading to a failure to wrap adapters for null handling when expected.
Swap the arguments passed to the TypeAdapterFactory.create() method, passing fieldType and gson instead of gson and fieldType.
Invert the null check on typeAdapter, attempting to call nullSafe() only when it is null (which would cause a NullPointerException).
Change the type adapter factory branch check to check if it's assignable from TypeAdapter.class instead of TypeAdapterFactory.class, causing factory logic errors.
Modify the fallback exception message string slightly, which breaks strict string matching if any test asserts on the exact exception message.
